title: New Kids Scooter 2-Wheel Adjustable Height Scooter With Handbrake For 6-12 Years
body_html:
Features:
1、Equipped with ergonomic handlebars with foam pads to ensure a comfortable grip.
2、The rear wheel is equipped with a protective plate to prevent rainwater from splashing up and to block mud.
3、The footrest is large enough to provide ample standing space, allowing you to stand comfortably.
4、Equipped with an effective rear wheel friction brake, it can be easily operated with your foot for convenient use.
5、Suitable as a gift for children, perfect for birthdays, Children's Day, Christmas, and other occasions, giving them a surprise.

Specifications:
Color: black
Wheel: PU material
Material: metal+aluminum alloy+plastic
Load capacity: maximum 100kg

 Package Included:
1x Kids Scooter
